mapper.sql: isp.id AS id, isp.reference AS adjNO, isp.date AS `date`, isp.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, isp.location_group_id AS warehouseId, lg.name AS warehouseName, isp.pgroup_id AS productGroupId, lg.name AS productGroupName, isp.note AS description, isp.created AS created, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS createdBy, isp.created AS modified, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS modifiedBy, isp.status AS status

FROM inventory_sample_products isp LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = isp.company_id LEFT JOIN location_groups lg ON lg.id = isp.location_group_id LEFT JOIN pgroups ON pgroups.id = isp.pgroup_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = isp.created_by
p.id, p.code AS sku, p.barcode AS upc, p.name AS `name`, u.abbr AS uom, p.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate

FROM products p INNER JOIN uoms u ON u.id = p.price_uom_id INNER JOIN product_pgroups pgp ON pgp.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN pgroups pg ON pg.id = pgp.pgroup_id LEFT JOIN user_pgroups upg ON upg.pgroup_id = pg.id

WHERE 1=1
AND p.barcode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.upc}, '%')
AND p.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.sku}, '%')
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')
AND pgp.pgroup_id = #{filter.locationGroupId}
AND (pg.user_apply = 0 OR (pg.user_apply = 1 AND upg.user_id = #{filter.userId}))
mapper.select: SELECT inventory_sample_product_details.id AS id, inventory_sample_product_details.inventory_sample_product_id AS inventorySampleProductId, products.code AS code, products.code AS sku, products.unit_cost AS unitCost, uoms.name AS uom, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, products.barcode AS upc, inventory_sample_product_details.product_id AS productId, products.name AS productName, inventory_sample_product_details.location_id AS locationId, locations.name AS locationName, products.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, IFNULL(inventory_sample_product_details.lots_number, '0') AS lotsNumber, inventory_sample_product_details.expired_date AS expiredDate, inventory_sample_product_details.new_qty AS newQty, inventory_sample_product_details.qty_difference AS adjustQty, inventory_sample_product_details.current_qty AS qtyOnHand FROM inventory_sample_product_details LEFT JOIN locations ON inventory_sample_product_details.location_id = locations.id LEFT JOIN products ON inventory_sample_product_details.product_id = products.id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = products.price_uom_id WHERE inventory_sample_product_details.inventory_sample_product_id = #{inventorySampleProductId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_sample_products ( company_id, reference, date, note, location_group_id, pgroup_id, created_by, created ) VALUES ( #{inventorySample.companyId}, #{inventorySample.reference}, #{inventorySample.date}, #{inventorySample.description}, #{inventorySample.warehouseId}, #{inventorySample.pgroupId}, #{inventorySample.createdBy}, NOW() )
mapper.update: INSERT INTO inventory_sample_products ( company_id, reference, `date`, note, location_group_id, pgroup_id, created_by, created ) VALUES ( #{inventorySample.companyId}, #{inventorySample.reference}, #{inventorySample.date}, #{inventorySample.description}, #{inventorySample.warehouseId}, #{inventorySample.pgroupId}, #{inventorySample.modifiedBy}, NOW() )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_sample_product_details ( inventory_sample_product_id, product_id, location_id, expired_date, current_qty, new_qty, qty_difference ) VALUES ( #{inventorySample.inventorySampleProductId}, #{inventorySample.productId}, #{inventorySample.locationId}, #{inventorySample.expiredDate}, #{inventorySample.qtyOnHand}, #{inventorySample.newQty}, #{inventorySample.adjustQty} )
